sentences.en: They plan to evacuate all nonessential personnel from the embassy.
sentences.zh: 他们计划从大使馆撤离所有非必要员工。

sentences.en: Mr Yamada is in charge of the personnel section.
sentences.zh: 山田先生负责人事部门。

sentences.en: The rest of the personnel were fired without notice.
sentences.zh: 其余员工在未被告知的情况下被解雇了。

senses.zh: （公司、组织或军队中的）全体人员，员工；人事部门
